newsitem.title: FRANCE: CNPF head sees 2.4 pct 1997 growth as optimistic.
newsitem.headline: CNPF head sees 2.4 pct 1997 growth as optimistic.

text.p: The head of the French employers federation CNPF said on Tuesday he believed a government forecast of a minimum 2.4 percent growth in 1997 was slightly optimistic.
"If he (Prime Minister Alain Juppe) said a floor of 2.4 percent I think it is a bit optimistic," Jean Gandois told Reuters. Earlier Gandois said he expected growth of two percent for 1997.
Juppe earlier said on Europe 1 radio "We have a budget law which foresees growth of around 2.4 percent," Juppe said. "It's not a ceiling, it's a floor."
